title: quercus brutia subsp. pedunculiflora
intro: Quercus brutia subsp. pedunculiflora, commonly known as Eastern Turkey Oak, is a subspecies of oak tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus brutia subsp. pedunculiflora include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
